parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the driver. On the **Driver Management** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotIds
parameters.description:
The list of device IDs. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query information about all devices under the current account and obtain the IotId of each device.

> A maximum of 20 devices can be bound in a single call.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
